page_subtitle: Your personal keys for workspace access (MCP search and indexing). A key value is only shown at creation.
empty: No API keys. Create one and pick its access level.
revoke_confirm_body: The key becomes immediately invalid. Irreversible action.
create_dialog_desc: Name the key, then pick its access level.
created_key_warning: This key will never be shown again. Copy it before closing.
rotate_confirm: A new key will be generated with the same access. The old one stays valid for 72 hours.

scope.title: Access level
scope.help: The level applies to all workspaces. Each level includes the capabilities of the previous one.

read.label: Read
read.help: Search and read (MCP) across all workspaces.

read_write.label: Read / write
read_write.help: On top of read: indexing and push.

admin.label: Admin
admin.help: On top of write: library management (strategies, prompts, models) via MCP.

mcp_token_hint: Access token → one of your API keys (API keys page), read level minimum
keys_moved_body: Access keys are now personal and managed in Configuration → API keys. Each key has a level (read, read/write or admin) that applies to all workspaces.

mcp.title: Connect an MCP client
mcp.subtitle: Standard HTTP (Streamable) transport. A single endpoint for all workspaces. Copy the endpoint and header, or the ready-to-paste config block for your client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop…).
mcp.workspaces_note: First call the “list_workspaces” tool to discover the slugs, then pass the slug as the “workspace” parameter of the other tools.
mcp.placeholder_note: A key's value is shown only at creation: replace <VOTRE_CLÉ_API> with yours.
mcp.dialog_desc: Settings to wire an MCP client to this key.
